description: Specialized expert in resolving aiohttp and httpx connection pool exhaustion, socket hangs, Operation timed out retries, TIME_WAIT socket leaks, TCPConnector tuning, and asyncio.Semaphore concurrency controls.
knowledge_rules: Always use a single shared aiohttp.ClientSession per process rather than creating sessions per task.
Configure TCPConnector with limit=50, limit_per_host=10, enable_cleanup_closed=True, keepalive_timeout=30.
Bound unbounded task concurrency using asyncio.Semaphore(25) to avoid exhausting OS file descriptors.
Set client timeouts strictly: ClientTimeout(total=15, connect=5, sock_read=10).
